name: B3LYP
description: B3LYP hybrid density functional (Becke 3-parameter, Lee-Yang-Parr). One of the most widely used hybrid functionals. Requires a basis set.

name: PBE
description: PBE GGA density functional (Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof). Pure DFT, faster than hybrids.

name: PBE0
description: PBE0 hybrid density functional (25% exact exchange). Good balance of accuracy and cost.

name: r2SCAN
description: r2SCAN meta-GGA functional. Improved regularized SCAN with better numerical stability.

name: wB97X-D3
description: Range-separated hybrid functional with D3 dispersion correction. Excellent for thermochemistry and non-covalent interactions.

name: HF
description: Hartree-Fock method. No correlation energy. Basis for post-HF methods.

name: DLPNO-CCSD(T)
description: Domain-based local pair natural orbital CCSD(T). Near-linear scaling coupled-cluster method for large systems. Recommended with tightSCF and appropriate auxiliary basis.

name: DLPNO-CCSD(T1)
description: DLPNO-CCSD(T) with iterative triples correction (T1). More accurate than (T) approximation for non-covalent and open-shell systems.

name: def2-SVP
description: Karlsruhe def2 split-valence polarization basis set. Suitable for geometry optimizations and screening calculations.

name: def2-TZVP
description: Karlsruhe def2 triple-zeta valence polarization basis set. Good balance of accuracy and computational cost for single-point energies.

name: def2-TZVPP
description: Karlsruhe def2 triple-zeta valence double-polarization basis set. More polarization functions than def2-TZVP.

name: def2-QZVPP
description: Karlsruhe def2 quadruple-zeta valence double-polarization basis set. High accuracy for benchmark calculations.

name: cc-pVDZ
description: Dunning correlation-consistent polarized valence double-zeta basis set. Designed for systematic convergence to CBS limit.

name: cc-pVTZ
description: Dunning correlation-consistent polarized valence triple-zeta basis set.

name: aug-cc-pVDZ
description: Augmented Dunning cc-pVDZ basis set with diffuse functions. Important for anions and excited states.

name: aug-cc-pVTZ
description: Augmented Dunning cc-pVTZ basis set with diffuse functions. Good for accurate energetics with anions and Rydberg states.

name: RIJCOSX
description: RI approximation for Coulomb integrals (J) combined with seminumerical exchange (COSX). Greatly accelerates hybrid DFT. Requires AutoAux or explicit auxiliary basis.

name: RI-JK
description: RI approximation for both Coulomb (J) and exchange (K) integrals. Suitable for HF and post-HF calculations.

name: RI
description: Resolution-of-identity (density fitting) approximation. Accelerates pure DFT calculations significantly.

name: NORI
description: Disable RI approximation. Forces exact four-center integrals.

name: AutoAux
description: Automatically generate auxiliary basis sets for RI/RIJCOSX. Convenient when no pre-defined auxiliary basis is available.

name: tightSCF
description: Tight SCF convergence criteria (energy threshold 1e-8 Eh). Recommended for geometry optimizations and high-accuracy calculations including DLPNO-CCSD(T).

name: verytightSCF
description: Very tight SCF convergence criteria (energy threshold 1e-9 Eh). Use for benchmark calculations requiring highest precision.

name: normalSCF
description: Normal SCF convergence criteria (energy threshold 1e-6 Eh). Default convergence setting.

name: looseSCF
description: Loose SCF convergence criteria (energy threshold 1e-5 Eh). Suitable for pre-optimizations or non-critical calculations.

name: Opt
description: Geometry optimization task. Optimizes molecular geometry to find energy minimum.

name: Freq
description: Frequency calculation task. Computes analytical or numerical second derivatives for vibrational frequencies and thermochemistry.

name: OptFreq
description: Combined geometry optimization followed by frequency calculation at the optimized geometry.

name: NEB
description: Nudged elastic band calculation for finding minimum energy pathways and transition states.

name: IRC
description: Intrinsic reaction coordinate calculation to follow reaction path from transition state.

name: maxcore
description: Maximum memory per MPI process in MB (set via %maxcore). Each parallel process will use at most this amount of memory.

name: nprocs
description: Number of parallel MPI processes (set via %pal nprocs N end). Must match the number of CPU cores allocated.

name: MaxIter
description: Maximum number of SCF iterations (set in %scf block). Increase for difficult convergence cases.

name: ConvForced
description: Force SCF to converge even if not fully converged (set in %scf block). Use with caution as results may be unreliable.

name: NRoots
description: Number of excited states to compute in TDDFT/EOM calculation (set in %tddft block).

name: TDA
description: Enable Tamm-Dancoff approximation (TDA) in TDDFT. Faster but less rigorous than full TDDFT.

name: charge
description: Total charge of the molecule (in coordinate block header * xyz charge mult). Positive for cations, negative for anions.

name: multiplicity
description: Spin multiplicity of the molecule (in coordinate block header * xyz charge mult). 1=singlet, 2=doublet, 3=triplet, etc.
